import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def solve(prices, split_factors):
    # Ensure prices and split_factors have the same shape and index
    if prices.shape != split_factors.shape:
        raise ValueError("Prices and split_factors must have the same shape")
    
    # Calculate the adjusted prices using the split factors
    adjusted_prices = prices * split_factors
    
    # Initialize the weights DataFrame with zeros
    weights = pd.DataFrame(np.zeros_like(prices), index=prices.index, columns=prices.columns)
    
    # Define the lookback period for calculating returns
    lookback_period = 21
    
    # Iterate over the data starting from the earliest nonzero-capable row
    for i in range(lookback_period, len(prices)):
        # Calculate the returns for the current day
        returns = adjusted_prices.iloc[i] / adjusted_prices.iloc[i - 1]
        
        # Calculate the sample standard deviation of the last 20 returns
        std_dev = returns.iloc[:-1].std(ddof=1)
        
        # Calculate the momentum factor
        momentum_factor = np.sign(returns.iloc[-1] - returns.iloc[0]) * min(1, 0.10 / (std_dev * np.sqrt(252)))
        
        # Assign the momentum factor to the corresponding row in the weights DataFrame
        weights.iloc[i] = momentum_factor / 4
    
    return weights
